# BanglaEV — বাংলাদেশের সেরা EV গাইড

> Bilingual (Bengali + English) editorial hub for electric vehicles in Bangladesh.
> Prices, specs, comparisons, and news for BYD, MG, Hyundai and other EVs available
> through authorised distributors like CG Runner BD Ltd.

Website: https://banglaev.com
Sitemap: https://banglaev.com/sitemap.xml

## Key pages

- [Home](https://banglaev.com/): featured EVs, latest news, cost calculator.
- [BYD Bangladesh hub](https://banglaev.com/byd): every BYD model, showroom addresses, FAQ.
- [All models](https://banglaev.com/models): full catalogue with prices and specs.
- [Compare](https://banglaev.com/compare): side-by-side EV comparison tool.
- [Charging guide](https://banglaev.com/charging): public DC stations and home charging.
- [Cost calculator](https://banglaev.com/calculator): EV vs petrol running cost.
- [News](https://banglaev.com/news): reviews, launches, policy updates.
- [About](https://banglaev.com/about): mission, contact, partnerships.
- [Best electric bikes guide](https://banglaev.com/guide/best-electric-bikes-bangladesh): buyer's guide, top picks, costs and FAQ.

## Content policy

- Prices are quoted in BDT and dated with "সর্বশেষ আপডেট". Verify with the authorised
  distributor before purchase.
- Editorial content is produced by BanglaEV; brand names are trademarks of their owners.
- No login required; all editorial pages are public.
